interaction: Choose the patient — Dog, Cat, Rabbit or Bird — from the hero or the header switcher, and the whole site re-themes with a view-transition morph: accent colour, the animated SVG character and its speech bubble, footprint trail, team scrubs, the re-sorted service cards and their wording, care tips, the new-client form and an illustrative 'human years' age slider.
notes: Browsers without the View Transitions API switch themes with CSS colour transitions instead. The new-client form ends in a demo toast; prices are samples and health content is general information only.
